description: Java class implementing a message mapping function for incoming messages using JavaScript scripting, involving conversion of ExternalMessage objects to Adaptable objects, with integration of Rhino JavaScript engine.

classes.name: ScriptedIncomingMapping
classes.description: Implements a mapping function for incoming messages using JavaScript scripting, converting ExternalMessage to List<Adaptable>.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the mapping function to an ExternalMessage, executing JavaScript code to produce Adaptable objects.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageToNativeObject
methods.description: Converts ExternalMessage to a NativeObject suitable for JavaScript processing.

methods.name: getAdaptableFromObject
methods.description: Converts a JavaScript object result into an Adaptable instance via JSON serialization/deserialization.
